Region:World News
Two groups of monkeys in China made a fight scene in front of tourists, reports the Daily Mail.
The incident occurred on Mount Emei, located in Sichuan Province.
The video shows that the animals do not dare to attack each other at first, but later take active actions.
The last footage of the video shows that in the end people scatter monkeys.
Chinese Buddhists consider mount Emei as a sacred place.
It is also a popular tourist destination.
